summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The John Hancock Multifactor Developed International ETF (JHMD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of stocks from developed markets ex-US and Canada, covering 85% of the market capitalization. Holdings are weighted based on fundamental and technical factors JHMD was launched on Dec 15, 2016 and is issued by John Hancock.
infoTable: John Hancock Dimensional Developed International Index

holdings.infoBox: JHMD is an equity ETF with a total of 570 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 2.10%, Jh Collateral at 1.59%, Vinci at 1.48%, Shell at 1.42%, and Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria at 1.13%.
